outcome.Summary: Implemented the generic LRU cache in lru/lru.go using a map plus a sentinel doubly-linked list (all ops O(1) except Keys, which walks the list MRU→LRU). New panics on capacity < 1; Get/Put update recency; capacity evictions (not Remove or update) fire the OnEvict callback. Added lru/lru_test.go with 10 tests covering all API behaviors, keeping the pre-existing TestBasic. Verified with `go vet ./...` and `go test ./... -count=1`, which exit 0.
